name: Protection From Evil
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the ultimate protector for those who trust in Him, providing refuge and strength in times of trouble. The psalmist affirms that the LORD, as a shepherd, ensures His people lack nothing and safely shelters them under His care. Believers who fear the LORD are promised satisfaction and deliverance from evil, as God’s hand defends against enemies and revives the faithful amidst adversity. This divine protection is accessed by dwelling in God’s presence and looking to Him as the source of help.
